def solution():
    rsi_values = [40.5, 42.3, 41.8, 45.2, 47.6, 49.0, 51.3, 48.7, 46.8, 44.9, 42.1, 39.5, 37.2, 36.4, 35.0]
    lookback_period = 5

    window = rsi_values[-lookback_period:]
    min_rsi = min(window)
    max_rsi = max(window)
    stoch_rsi = (window[-1] - min_rsi) / (max_rsi - min_rsi) if max_rsi != min_rsi else 0

    return round(stoch_rsi, 2)
